name: Square MCP
tagline: Manage Square payments, inventory, and customers from chat.
shortDescription: The Square MCP server. View payments, manage inventory, list customers, create invoices, and process refunds. Square's full commerce platform.
longDescription:
## What it is

Square's official MCP server. Exposes the Square API as MCP tools: list payments, manage inventory, list customers, create invoices, process refunds, and view sales reports.

## Why we recommend it

If you use Square for in-person or online payments, this is the cleanest way to let an agent help. The agent can pull daily sales, manage inventory, and even issue refunds.

## When to use it

- Sales reports: agent pulls 'sales today' or 'top items this week'
- Inventory: agent updates stock levels, alerts on low stock
- Customers: agent finds customers, looks up purchase history
- Invoices: agent creates and sends invoices
installInstructions:
1. Create a Square app at https://developer.squareup.com/apps
2. Get an access token (sandbox or production)
3. Set `SQUARE_ACCESS_TOKEN=...` and `SQUARE_ENVIRONMENT=sandbox` (or `production`)
4. `npx -y @square/mcp`
pricingDetails: Free. The MCP server is open source. Square: 2.6% + $0.10 per in-person transaction. Online: 2.9% + $0.30.
